title: Accountant / Accounts Executive
description:
Roles and Responsibilities 
 Prepare sales invoices, credit notes, debit notes, e-way bills, E-invoicing, GST returns (BAS), TDS returns (TCS return), Tally ERP reports.
 Conduct bank reconciliations and prepare audit reports.
 Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, and general accounting tasks.
 Provide support for quote preparation and purchase entry management.
 Ensure timely submission of taxes and compliance with regulatory requirements.

Key Skills: Accounting,Tally,TDS,Tally ERP,Quote Preparation,GST,Sales Entry,Purchase Entry
